Below is a 12‑week, gym-based programme designed for a 45-year-old woman with type 2 diabetes (on metformin, HbA1c 7.2%) targeting fat loss, improved glycaemic control, strength, and cardio‑metabolic fitness. It includes phased training, specific sessions with sets/reps, and a structured nutrition and recovery plan tailored to diabetes considerations.

Important notes
- Medical clearance: Confirm physician clearance and any contraindications; verify no diabetes complications (retinopathy, neuropathy, nephropathy, CVD) that would modify exercise selection or intensity.
- Hypoglycaemia risk: Metformin alone has low hypoglycaemia risk, but monitor symptoms, especially with caloric deficit and exercise. Encourage self-monitoring of blood glucose (SMBG) around new exercise stimuli and longer sessions.
- Foot care: Prioritize well-fitting footwear; daily foot checks due to potential neuropathy risk.
- Progression: Increase volume/intensity conservatively; modify for joint comfort.

Global training structure (12 weeks)
- Frequency: 4 training days/week + optional low-intensity activity on other days.
- Phases:
  - Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Foundation — technique, aerobic base, neuromuscular control.
  - Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Progressive overload — higher strength volume, moderate HIIT, increased step targets.
  - Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Intensification & metabolic conditioning — heavier loads, mixed-modal conditioning, adherence focus.

Weekly schedule template
- Day 1: Full-body strength A + steady aerobic
- Day 2: Low-impact cardio + core/mobility
- Day 3: Full-body strength B + intervals (build to HIIT)
- Day 4: Active recovery (walks) or rest
- Day 5: Full-body strength C + steady aerobic
- Day 6: Low-impact cardio (longer) + mobility
- Day 7: Rest (optional light walk, stretch)

Session warm-up (all sessions)
- 5–8 min easy cardio (RPE 3–4).
- Dynamic mobility: ankle rocks, hip openers, T-spine rotations (1–2 sets x 6–8 each).
- Movement prep: bodyweight squats, band rows, glute bridges (1 x 8–10).

Intensity guide
- RPE scale 1–10; keep strength sets at ~RIR 2 (two reps in reserve) unless noted.
- Cardio: use RPE or %HRmax (estimate 220 − age).

Phase 1: Weeks 1–4 (Foundation)
Goals: Learn movements, establish consistency, accumulate steps (7–9k/day), build aerobic base, begin mild deficit.

Strength parameters
- 2–3 sets, 8–12 reps, RPE 6–7 (RIR 2–3), 60–75 s rest.
- Tempo 2–1–2; controlled eccentrics.

Cardio parameters
- Steady-state at RPE 4–5; start 20–30 min, build to 35 min.
- Intervals: gentle intro in W3–4 (see below).

Week 1
- Day 1 Strength A:
  - Goblet squat 3 x 8–10
  - Machine chest press 3 x 8–10
  - Seated row (cable) 3 x 10–12
  - Romanian deadlift (DB) 2 x 10
  - Half-kneeling cable chop 2 x 12/side
  - Finisher: Treadmill brisk walk 15–20 min RPE 4
- Day 2 Cardio + Core:
  - Bike or elliptical 25 min RPE 4
  - Dead bug 3 x 8/side; Side plank 3 x 20–30 s/side
  - Mobility 8–10 min
- Day 3 Strength B:
  - Leg press 3 x 10–12
  - Lat pulldown 3 x 8–10
  - DB incline press 3 x 8–10
  - Step-up (box height to tolerance) 2 x 10/leg
  - Cable face pull 2 x 12–15
  - Finisher: Row erg 12–15 min RPE 4
- Day 5 Strength C:
  - Hip hinge patterning: KB deadlift 3 x 8–10
  - DB shoulder press 3 x 8–10
  - Cable or machine hip abduction 2 x 12–15
  - Assisted TRX row 2 x 10–12
  - Glute bridge 2 x 12–15
  - Finisher: Bike 15–20 min RPE 4
- Day 6 Cardio Long:
  - Walk outdoors or elliptical 30–35 min RPE 4; Stretch 8–10 min

Week 2
- Strength: Same exercises; add 1 set to first two lifts each session or +2.5–5% load if RPE <6.
- Cardio: Add 5 min to steady sessions (target 30–35 min on Days 1/5 finisher, 30 min Day 2; 35–40 min Day 6).

Week 3
- Strength: Progress load or reps (stay 8–12 range). Add single-leg balance: split squat 2 x 8/side on Day 1 (replace step-ups Day 3 if needed).
- Intervals intro (Day 3 after strength):
  - 6 x 1 min at RPE 7 with 2 min easy between on bike.
- Steady: Maintain 30–35 min other days.

Week 4
- Strength: Slight variation to build skill.
  - Swap goblet squat → front squat to box (light), leg press → hack squat machine light, DB press → machine, pulldown → single-arm pulldown.
- Intervals: 7 x 1 min RPE 7, 90 s easy.
- Steady: One session 40 min (Day 6). Steps 8–10k/day.

Phase 2: Weeks 5–8 (Progressive overload)
Goals: Increase strength volume, introduce moderate HIIT, elevate weekly energy expenditure, steps 9–11k/day.

Strength parameters
- 3–4 sets, 6–10 reps main lifts, 10–15 reps accessories; RPE 7–8 (RIR 1–2), 75–90 s rest.

Cardio parameters
- 1–2 interval sessions/week; 1–2 steady sessions 30–40 min.

Week 5
- Day 1 Strength A:
  - Back squat to box or goblet squat heavy 4 x 6–8
  - Bench or machine chest press 4 x 6–8
  - Seated row 3 x 8–10
  - Romanian deadlift 3 x 8–10
  - Pallof press 3 x 10/side
  - Finisher: Treadmill incline walk 20–25 min RPE 5
- Day 2 Cardio + Core:
  - Elliptical 30–35 min RPE 4–5
  - Core circuit x 2: dead bug 10/side, bird dog 8/side, side plank 30–40 s/side
- Day 3 Strength B + Intervals:
  - Leg press 4 x 8–10
  - Lat pulldown 4 x 6–8
  - DB incline press 3 x 8–10
  - Split squat 3 x 8/leg
  - Face pull 3 x 12–15
  - Intervals: 8 x 1 min RPE 8, 90 s easy (bike)
- Day 5 Strength C:
  - Trap bar deadlift or KB deadlift heavy 4 x 6–8
  - DB shoulder press 3 x 8–10
  - Chest-supported DB row 3 x 8–10
  - Hip thrust 3 x 10–12
  - Farmer carry 3 x 30–40 m
  - Finisher: Row 20 min RPE 5
- Day 6 Cardio Long: 40 min brisk walk RPE 4–5 + mobility

Week 6
- Progress loads +2.5–5% if RPE <7. Add one accessory set on Days 1/3/5.
- Intervals: 6 x 90 s RPE 8, 2 min easy.
- Steady: Maintain volumes; add 5 min to one session.

Week 7
- Slight variation:
  - Swap squat → hack squat; press → push-up on Smith assisted as needed; pulldown → single-arm cable pulldown; hinge → Romanian DL with barbell.
- Intervals: 10 x 1 min RPE 8, 60–75 s easy.
- Add sled push or bike metcon finisher 6–8 min easy-moderate on Day 5.

Week 8 (deload-lite for strength, maintain cardio)
- Reduce main lift volume by ~20–25% (fewer sets) while keeping intensity moderate.
- Intervals: 8 x 1 min RPE 7.5, 75–90 s easy.
- Reassess technique, aches, shoes, adherence.

Phase 3: Weeks 9–12 (Intensification & metabolic conditioning)
Goals: Preserve/advance strength, increase metabolic stress safely, consolidate habits, steps 10–12k/day (as tolerated).

Strength parameters
- Main lifts 4 x 5–8 at RPE 7.5–8.5; accessories 2–3 x 10–15; incorporate short density blocks.

Cardio parameters
- 1 HIIT session, 1 tempo/threshold session, 1 steady long.

Week 9
- Day 1 Strength A:
  - Squat pattern 4 x 5–6 (heavier)
  - Bench or machine press 4 x 5–6
  - Row 3 x 8–10
  - RDL 3 x 8
  - Density accessory 8 min: alternate kettlebell swing (light) 10 + walking lunge 10 steps, repeat at RPE 7.
  - Finisher: Incline walk 15–20 min RPE 5

Here is the complete 12-week programme integrating all prior adjustments: diabetes-aware training, morning fasted cardio, intensified Phase 3, structured nutrition with a weekly free meal, and guidance on intermittent fasting as an optional timing tool.

Global framework (Weeks 1–12)
- Frequency: 4 gym days/week + 2–3 low-impact cardio/mobility days
- Added fasted cardio: 2–5 mornings/week (LISS only; details by phase)
- Weekly layout template:
  - Mon: AM fasted LISS; PM Strength A + short steady finisher (fed)
  - Tue: AM fasted LISS + core/mobility (fed after)
  - Wed: PM Strength B + intervals (fed; no fasted HIIT)
  - Thu: AM fasted LISS (recovery pace)
  - Fri: AM optional fasted LISS; PM Strength C + steady finisher (fed)
  - Sat: Longer steady cardio (can be fasted if RPE ≤5); mobility
  - Sun: Rest or light walk
- Warm-up every session: 5–8 min easy cardio (RPE 3–4), dynamic mobility (ankle rocks, hip openers, T-spine rotations 1–2 x 6–8), movement prep (BW squats, band rows, glute bridges 1 x 8–10)
- Intensity guides:
  - Strength: RPE 6–8.5 across phases; stop with 1–3 reps in reserve
  - Cardio: LISS RPE 3–5; Tempo RPE 6–7; HIIT hard efforts RPE 8.5–9 (fed only)
- Diabetes safety:
  - SMBG checks when introducing new intensities: pre and 60–120 min post
  - Pre-exercise targets: 90–250 mg/dL; if <90 with symptoms, take 10–15 g carb; if >250 mg/dL with symptoms or unwell, delay and hydrate
  - Foot care, hydration, and carry quick carbs even though metformin has low hypo risk

Phase 1: Foundation (Weeks 1–4)
Goals: Technique, consistency, aerobic base, step target 7–9k/day, start mild calorie deficit

Strength parameters: 2–3 sets, 8–12 reps, RPE 6–7, 60–75 s rest
Cardio parameters: Steady state RPE 4–5 for 20–35 min; intervals begin Week 3

Fasted cardio progression:
- Week 1: 2–3 sessions, 20–25 min, RPE 3–4
- Week 2: 3 sessions, 25–30 min
- Week 3: 3–4 sessions, 25–30 min (optional 2–3 x 60 s pickups at RPE 6 at end)
- Week 4: 3–4 sessions, 25–35 min

Week 1
- Mon (Strength A + steady finisher)
  - Goblet squat 3 x 8–10
  - Machine chest press 3 x 8–10
  - Seated cable row 3 x 10–12
  - DB Romanian deadlift 2 x 10
  - Half-kneeling cable chop 2 x 12/side
  - Steady finisher: Treadmill brisk walk 15–20 min RPE 4
- Tue (AM fasted LISS): 20–25 min walk/bike RPE 3–4; Core: dead bug 3 x 8/side, side plank 3 x 20–30 s/side; mobility 8–10 min
- Wed (Strength B)
  - Leg press 3 x 10–12
  - Lat pulldown 3 x 8–10
  - DB incline press 3 x 8–10
  - Step-up 2 x 10/leg
  - Cable face pull 2 x 12–15
  - Steady finisher: Row erg 12–15 min RPE 4
- Thu (AM fasted LISS): 20–25 min RPE 3–4
- Fri (Strength C + finisher)
  - KB deadlift 3 x 8–10
  - DB shoulder press 3 x 8–10
  - Machine/cable hip abduction 2 x 12–15
  - TRX row (assisted) 2 x 10–12
  - Glute bridge 2 x 12–15
  - Bike 15–20 min RPE 4
- Sat (Steady long): 30–35 min walk/elliptical RPE 4; mobility 8–10 min

Nutrition plan (fat loss + glycaemic control)
- Calories: Start ~20% below TDEE. Example 170 lb female TDEE ≈ 2400–2550 kcal; target ≈ 1900–2050 kcal/day. Adjust by ±100–150 kcal based on 2-week weight trend and energy.
- Protein: 0.8–1.0 g/lb goal bodyweight (1.6–2.2 g/kg), split over 3–4 meals.
- Carbohydrates: 35–45% of calories (or individualized to SMBG), fiber-forward, low–moderate GI. Slightly higher on heavy training days, lower on rest days.
- Fats: 25–35% calories; emphasize mono/polyunsaturated; sat fat <10%.
- Fiber: 25–35 g/day minimum. Veggies-first strategy.
- Hydration: 2–3 L/day; electrolytes if sweating.

Carb timing
- Pre-workout (fed strength/HIIT): 25–40 g low–moderate GI carbs + 20–30 g protein 60–120 min prior; lighter 10–20 g carbs + 20–30 g protein if <45 min prior.
- Post-workout: 25–45 g carbs + 25–35 g protein within 2 h.
- Fasted LISS: Water/electrolytes only; if fasting BG <90 mg/dL or session >35–40 min, take 10–15 g carbs and treat as semi-fasted. Eat balanced breakfast within 60 min after.

Weekly free (cheat) meal protocol
- One indulgent meal/week, not a day; schedule 2–4 h post hardest lifting/HIIT (Wed or Fri).
- Bank 300–500 kcal earlier that day via high-protein, low-starch, low-fat meals.
- Protein anchor ≥30 g in the free meal; add salad/veg and vinegar/lemon starter.
- Portion ideas: 2 slices thin-crust pizza + big salad; burger (hold top bun or whole-grain) + shared small fries; fajitas with 2 corn tortillas; sushi 1–2 rolls + miso + edamame.
- Post-meal 10–15 min walk. SMBG 90–120 min post-meal at first; adjust portions next week if consistently high.

Intermittent fasting (optional)
- Start 12:12 for 2–3 weeks; if well-tolerated, progress to 14:10 or selective 16:8 on some days.
- Keep strength/HIIT inside the eating window where possible. Fasted time is for LISS only.
- If lifting near end of fast, take 20–30 g whey + 10–20 g carbs 15–30 min pre; full post-workout meal after.

Meal structure example (≈1900–2000 kcal)
- Breakfast (post-fasted LISS): 25–35 g protein + 25–40 g carbs
  - Greek yogurt (200 g) + berries + 1–2 tbsp chia; or omelet (2 eggs + 2 whites) + 1 slice sprouted toast + berries
- Lunch: 30–40 g protein + 30–45 g carbs + veg
  - Chicken salad bowl with chickpeas 1/2 cup; olive oil/lemon
- Snack: 20–30 g protein + 10–20 g carbs
  - Skyr or whey shake + fruit
- Dinner: 30–40 g protein; carbs 20–40 g based on training that day
  - Salmon + roasted veg + 1/2 cup quinoa or sweet potato
- Post-dinner (if needed): Low-carb protein/fat (string cheese, 1 oz nuts)

Post-workout snack ideas (quick)
- Whey shake + 1 piece of fruit
- Greek yogurt (200 g) + berries
- Cottage cheese cup + pineapple 1/2 cup
- RTD protein milk + thin slice sprouted toast

Supplements (with physician okay)
- Whey/casein protein; creatine 3–5 g/day if kidney function normal; vitamin D3 if low; omega-3s if fish intake low.

Recovery, sleep, stress
- Sleep 7–9 h; finish eating 2–3 h before bed.
- 10–15 min mobility on training days; longer on Sat.
- Daily walks help glycaemia (especially post-meal).

Monitoring and adjustments
- Weight: weekly or biweekly trend; aim 0.5–1.0 lb/week loss
- SMBG: fasting, pre/post new intensities, and 90–120 min after the free meal and new snacks
- If catecholamine-related post-HIIT spikes occur, extend cool-down, add post-meal walk, and use lower-GI carbs; reduce pre-workout carbs slightly
- If progress stalls 2+ weeks:
  - Tighten free meal portions or alternate weeks
  - Reduce daily calories by ~100–150 kcal or add 10–15 min to 2 LISS sessions
  - Keep protein high; don’t cut sleep

End-of-program reassessment (Week 12)
- Retest key lifts (submax loads at same RPE), interval volumes/paces, waist circumference, resting HR, and weight trend
- Coordinate A1c recheck with physician about 12 weeks from start
- Decide on next block: maintain intensity or transition to a strength focus while holding new nutrition habits
